anomalies.observed: The schematic connects +5V to J1 pin 25 and J2 pin 27. Because both pins are on the same +5V net, those bus contacts are bridged; J1 pin 27 is not shown connected to +5V.
anomalies.expected: The specification says +5V is tied to pin 27 of both M-BUS connectors, and that J1 and J2 carry identical pass-through nets.

anomalies.impact: The board routes +5V to the wrong contact on J1 and ties that contact to J2 pin 27. This breaks the intended pass-through mapping and may put +5V on an unintended M5Stack bus contact.

parsed.summary: The M-BUS connectors do not have the specified matching +5V connection: J1 pin 25 is connected instead of pin 27. This also bridges J1 pin 25 and J2 pin 27 on the +5V net.
